utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re still short on screws, painter’s tape, and a couple extension cords. If you can grab those, I’ll have the rest lined up when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it, I’ll grab those and head over a bit later.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, thanks, Dane — I’ll keep everything else organized and ready for when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll bring the drill, hammer, screwdrivers, tape measure, and a few wrenches, and I’ll keep the time flexible around school pickup and drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — I’ll note the tools and keep the timing flexible too. Let me know once the date and time are set.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Will do, Hana — once we lock in the date and time, I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, thanks—have you heard anything new about what they still need or when they’re expecting folks to show up?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I haven’t checked yet, but I’ll keep an eye out and let you know as soon as I hear what they still need or when folks should come by.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Bo — I appreciate it. I’ll wait to hear the update on what they still need and when to stop by.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got it noted at the community hall on Maple Street. If you want, I can also read back the other locations one by one.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’d be great—please read them back one by one so I can make sure everything’s right.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sure — the repair drive is at the community hall on Maple Street.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam — Sunday at the community center works better now. Send the list when you can, and I’ll help line up the neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Rosa — I’ll send the list over when it’s ready and I’m happy to help with the neighbor outreach too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Sam — I appreciate it. Once the list arrives, I’ll start coordinating the neighbors and keep everything set for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure — I’m planning to stop by the repair drive later, then I’ll check what they still need and tell you the timing and what’s being hauled.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — just let me know what they still need and when it’s happening.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: You got it — I’m planning to stop by the repair drive later, and I’ll let you know what they still need and when it’s happening.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Oren, can you check your list and tell me exactly what tools are still missing?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m checking it now — I think we’re still missing a hammer and maybe one screwdriver. I’ll send the exact list as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Oren — please send the exact list when you can.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m here—what still needs fixing for the repair drive? I can help sort out the missing supplies.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Dane — I think we still need to sort the repair list and figure out who hasn’t been contacted yet. If you can help with the missing supplies too, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure thing — I’ll help sort the missing supplies and take a look at who still needs contacting.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just confirming, it’s still on for today, right?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, it’s still on today. If you can, just bring the remaining supplies and we’ll sort the rest there.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — I’ll bring the remaining supplies. Just to confirm, nothing’s changed about the time or place, right?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Absolutely, Rosa — I can help make the list and reach out to a few neighbors. Just tell me which repairs you already know about, and I’ll get started.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thank you, Rey. So far I only know the repair drive is on Sunday at the community center, and I’ll send along any repair details I hear as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Perfect, Rosa — I’ll wait for the repair details and start lining up a few neighbors in the meantime.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, Gus, what do you still need most for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Mostly I just need the final date and time, then I can bring the right tools. For now, we should be ready for small fixes like loose hinges, shelves, and quick patch-up jobs.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great—what date and time should I put down for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can help with that—what’s the date and time, and should I spread the word about any specific repairs too?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be perfect — it’s this Saturday afternoon, and yes, please spread the word about any furniture or bike repairs we still need help with.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word about furniture and bike repairs for this Saturday afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good to me—just tell me the list and I’ll follow it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great—first is the leaky faucet, then the porch step, and we’ll finish by checking the lamps.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Perfect — I’ll start with the leaky faucet and then move to the porch step, and I’ll check the lamps last.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ll sort the repair list and check who still needs to be contacted first. Then I’ll send you the names and we can split up the follow-ups.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—great, thanks Mara. Send me the names when you have them and I’ll handle a few follow-ups.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ve got it — I’ll send you the names shortly so you can take a few follow-ups.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Vik — that would help. If you can share the timing and what’s being hauled, I can figure out the space we’ll need.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure — I’m planning to stop by the repair drive later, then I’ll check what they still need and let you know the timing and what’s being hauled.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Vik — that works. Once you know the timing and what’s being hauled, I can sort out the space we’ll need.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Bo — I can sort the donations and keep an eye on the drop-off table.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Sam — that’s a big help. I’ll check the latest on the repair drive and get back to you soon.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: No problem, Bo — I’ll keep sorting the donations and watch the drop-off table until you’re back.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Maple Street is noted for the repair drive. If you have any more locations, I can keep them simple and track them one by one.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little, but I need to keep things low-key right now. If there’s a simple task for the repair drive, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sure — I’ll keep it simple. Just tell me the next location, and I’ll note it for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — Saturday works. Could you remind me what time we’re meeting and what repairs or tools we should plan for?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: We’re meeting this Saturday around 10 AM, and it sounds like you’ve got that small roof leak and the loose front gate to handle. Let me know if you need any tools or anything else.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — 10 AM on Saturday works. I’ll plan for the roof leak and front gate, and I’ll check what tools we still need.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, it’s still on for today. Let’s make a quick list of what’s left so we can grab the last few things together.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just confirming — we’re still meeting today, right?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes — we’re still meeting today. I’m making a quick list of what’s left so we can grab the last few things together.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You got it — I’ll bring the list by soon so we can get everything lined up for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess. That would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course — I’ll swing by soon with the list, and we’ll get everything ready for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I can check the sign-up sheet next. After that, I can help with the tables if you still need it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Leo — that would be a big help. Please check the sign-up sheet first, and if you still have time, please help set up the tables after that.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Will do — I’ll check the sign-up sheet first and then help with the tables if I’ve got time.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Of course — I can keep an eye on the boxes and double-check the list so nothing slips through. Just point me to where you want me to start.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, thanks — please start with the tool boxes by the garage, and if anything looks short, let me know right away so I can reshuffle things.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Will do — I’ll start by the garage and flag anything missing right away.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thanks, Rey — the community hall on Maple Street is perfect. See you at 2, and I’ll make sure you know where everything is when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good, I’ll be there at 2. Just point me to where you need an extra hand.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — once you arrive, I’ll point you to the tool table and help you get settled. Thanks again, Rey!
